classification: paired holding-horizon comparison for a fixed weak-regime sentiment-reversal B sleeve
hypothesis: R363 fixed 50/50 intraday/close-position reversal blend improved the matched five-session B sleeve annual return and drawdown, but its latest-year return remained negative. Holding the same unchanged composite and 20pp score replacement for up to 20 sessions may reduce short-horizon noise and improve recent performance. R365 compares both candidate and its matched quality control at 20 sessions against their R363 five-session counterparts; only their horizon cap changes.
known_limits: R363 and R365 use the same overlapping historical panel and are not independent out-of-sample evidence.
Current THS industry membership is backfilled historically; industry classifications are not point-in-time.
HS300 membership history is daily snapshots after 2020-12 and monthly snapshots earlier; membership/survivorship bias remains.
The weak-regime entry filter is read from T-1 but sentiment/reversal inputs are mechanically related to recent price action.
A 20-session cap changes turnover, exposure overlap and stop/exit interactions; this tests the whole holding rule and does not identify a causal alpha mechanism.
The displayed 2x and 3x labels denote transaction-cost assumptions, not leverage. Portfolio gross exposure remains capped at 100%.

performance_gates.G1_candidate_recent_return_improves_at_l: R365 candidate recent 2x-cost return minus R363 candidate recent 2x-cost return >= +5 percentage points.
performance_gates.G2_20d_candidate_mdd_within_3pp_of_5d: R365 candidate MDD is no more than 3 percentage points deeper than R363 5d candidate MDD.
performance_gates.G3_20d_marginal_annual_edge_not_more_tha: 20d candidate-minus-control annual edge >= 5d candidate-minus-control edge - 1 percentage point.
performance_gates.G4_candidate_sharpe_within_0_10_of_5d: R365 candidate Sharpe >= R363 candidate Sharpe - 0.10.
performance_gates.G5_candidate_annual_at_least_control_min: 20d candidate 2x-cost annualized return >= 20d matched control - 1 percentage point.
performance_gates.G6_candidate_recent_not_worse_than_contr: 20d candidate recent 2x-cost return >= 20d matched control recent return.
performance_gates.G7_at_least_3_of_6_phase_starts_positive: At least three of six fixed phase-start candidate total returns are positive.
performance_gates.G8_candidate_3x_cost_annual_nonnegative: Candidate annualized return is nonnegative under the 3x transaction-cost assumption.

preflight_gates.D1: Candidate/control exact scoring, matching filters, 20-session cap and -20% stop.
preflight_gates.D2: Fixed 50/50 blend and both custom component factor columns materialize in isolated system feature path.
preflight_gates.D3: At least 100 T-1 weak-regime entry days.
preflight_gates.D4: At least 10 eligible current-HS300 candidates per weak entry day.
preflight_gates.D5: Composite mean weak-day factor coverage >=95%; minimum >=90%.
preflight_gates.D6: Both raw component factors mean weak-day coverage >=95%.
preflight_gates.D7: Each of six fixed phase starts has >=5 weak days.
preflight_gates.D8: Regime and membership history cover through frozen end.
preflight_gates.D9: All input/code/artifact fingerprints stable; preflight evaluates no forward returns or backtest metrics.

primary_metric.definition: (R365 candidate 2x-cost annual - R365 control 2x-cost annual) - (R363 5-session candidate 2x-cost annual - R363 5-session control 2x-cost annual)
primary_metric.name: difference_in_differences_annual

research_basis.R363: Five-session candidate annualized return 12.30%, Sharpe 0.579, MDD -23.33%, recent-year return -7.37%; paired quality control annualized 8.72%, Sharpe 0.457, MDD -25.89%, recent-year -11.71%. The factor replacement helped the paired historical profile but failed nonnegative recent return.
research_basis.design: Compare 20d candidate-minus-control annual edge to the same 5d edge (difference-in-differences), alongside recent-return change, Sharpe and drawdown. Do not compare the candidate to R362 single intraday factor because R363 is the matched same-factor five-day reference.

rule.execution: T close ranking; T+1 open entries and exits; no leverage, borrowing, paper target or orders
rule.only_candidate_control_difference: candidate replaces 20 percentage points of uf_quality_value_defensive with fixed weak-reversal composite; both use identical basic filter, T-1 weak regime, position count, stops and holding horizon
